export_controls.text: People are talking about data centers and AI and the need to beat China. Then they watch Nvidia's CEO embroiled in scandal and see how everybody is patting each other on the back, helping each other in the billionaire class and the ruling class gathering together. The average American is sitting in their hometown saying: I don't want a data center in my backyard that is going to suck up my water and my electricity, that is going to be processing computing that addicts my children to porn and sports gambling, while we ruin college sports and all the things that we enjoy on the weekend to take a break from this godforsaken political ruling class that is sticking it to us again.
.@CNBC: Rep. Chip Roy doesn't want to regulate AI, but says Congress should have an oversight role https://t.co/Bn22whZLD9

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses domestic AI regulation and congressional oversight, not export controls.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The text does not mention export controls or overseas AI access restrictions.
